Apparently having the tools required to do your job is a workplace perk now.

Move over unlimited PTO, free lunches, and health insurance. Silicon Valley has discovered the hottest new employee benefit: AI tokens.

Yes, companies are talking about putting AI token budgets and dedicated inference compute into job offers as recruiting perks. Which raises a pretty obvious question: if I need AI to perform the job you're paying me to do... why am I negotiating for access to it like it's a benefit?
